description.text: The International Preparatory Program of Beijing Institute of Technology is an undergraduate preparatory education for international students at Beijing Institute of Technology. The purpose is to help international students meet the undergraduate admission requirements of Beijing Institute of Technology through 1-2 semesters of language and basic subject study and consolidation. The main courses include Chinese language, mathematics, physics, Chinese cultural inheritance and scientific and technological innovation, cross-cultural communication and team management, etc. At the same time, students will be provided with HSK pre-exam training. Students who participate in this program and pass the assessment can directly enter the undergraduate program of our university.The Foundation course consists of two different programs:Program A (Offline program) : Applicants are international students with HSK4 level or equivalent Chinese language level, and have reached the undergraduate admission standard through one semester of Chinese language, mathematics, physics and other courses.Program B (Offline program) : Applicants are international students with HSK-3 level or equivalent Chinese language level, and have reached the undergraduate admission standard through one academic year of Chinese, mathematics, physics and other courses.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per semester ￥ 15000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: *1. Scanned copy of passport (passport photo first page and China visa page) **2. Document photo with white background *3. Highest degree certificate*4. High school transcripts *5. Personal Statement (Download the BIT International Student Personal Statement at https://isc.bit.edu.cn/→Resources→Download) template, fill in and upload to the application system attachment) 6. Application Materials for Student under 18 must be uploaded (if you are under 18, please Download Application materials for Student under 18 and upload all materials as required) 7. Physical Examination Form (please Download the Physical Examination Record for Foreigner in the "Download" section above, and upload the materials after going to the hospital for physical examination as required) 8. Financial security certificate (bank deposit certificate) 9. No crime certificate (to be issued at the local police station) 10. Other attachments (* is required)

requirements.text: Non-chinese citizens who have graduated from high school or above, have university application qualifications, are in good health, are willing to abide by relevant Chinese laws and regulations and school rules and regulations, and hold a valid foreign passport;Be between 18 and 25 years old. Under the age of 18, you must provide guardian documents in Beijing, China.
